camera_geometry.purpose: local stereo reconstruction and axis measurement

controller_tcp.source: device readback plus operator tool registration, existing configured reference

operational_grasp_tcp.application: software task frame; do not send its flange offset to controller as an implicit configuration change
operational_grasp_tcp.definition: can axis at successful finger-pad insertion, intersected with controller tool-X=0 plane; orientation is defined equal to existing controller tool axes

physical_pad_center_model.role: opening-dependent nominal tool geometry; retained separately from deeper operational object-axis placement

planning_equations.insertion_rule: geometric pad center is not a mandatory object-axis target; ensure sufficient overlap and palm clearance
planning_equations.object_offset_rule: a held object pose must be measured/stored relative to the grasp reference at actual closure; do not reuse old can coordinates

publication.reason: user elected to provide the new scene directory/template; not supplied yet

use_scope.margin_type: engineering planning margin, not a statistical confidence bound or certified absolute accuracy
use_scope.new_objects: reobserve target pose; choose insertion from object radius, pad overlap and palm clearance. This fixed insertion reference is validated at current opening only; other openings use existing geometry model and require local check.
